title: Criminal penalties.
bodyText: Any person who violates section 480E-10 is guilty of a class C felony and, in addition to any other penalties, shall be fined $10,000.
bodyHtml: [§480E-12]  Criminal penalties.  Any person who violates section 480E-10 is guilty of a class C felony and, in addition to any other penalties, shall be fined $10,000. [L 2012, c 183, pt of §1]
